title: Living in the Shadow of the Crater

warmUp.question: What are the psychological implications of residing in a region prone to seismic or volcanic instability?
warmUp.sampleAnswer: People may feel constant anxiety, or they may become unusually resilient.

vocabulary.sentence: Geothermal energy is abundant near the crater.
Ash is a remnant of the last eruption.
Villages on the slope are vulnerable.
The trauma of evacuation stays with them.
The volcano looked dormant for years.
The eruption lit the sky red.

sentenceFrames: People who live near a volcano must ____.

story.title: The Silent Sentinel

pages.heading: The Silent Sentinel
pages.text: The crater watched the village for decades. Most people called it dormant.

pages.heading: Signs of Awakening
pages.text: Seismic tremors grew stronger. Ash drifted onto the rooftops.

pages.heading: The Aftermath
pages.text: After the eruption, geothermal vents still warmed the valley. Trauma remained.

comprehensionQuestions.question: Why did people stay near the crater?
comprehensionQuestions.sampleAnswer: Because geothermal heat and habit made them stay.

creativeQuestions: Would you stay if you lived next to a volcano? Why?

speakingQuestions.question: Is living near a volcano worth the risk?
speakingQuestions.sampleAnswer: It depends on the benefits like geothermal power versus the danger.

speakingQuestions.question: How should a community prepare for an eruption?
What positive things can volcanoes provide?
How does trauma change a community after disaster?
speakingQuestions.sampleAnswer: People may support each other more, or some may leave forever.
